player_prompt.intro:
Am  Player {player_id} aad. Am 'Guess The Number' khelnaa. 
Aam {min_number} ar {max_number} hundaa saakhaa re {max_turns} tur tak aad khelnaa.
Aam aapan guess likhnaa, khel aapanaa 'baae' ar 'niche' hundaa emaan deeba.
Aam aapan jawaab kisiibhi tarahaan de saknaa. Khaalii wah number maanaa jaaeba jahaan third bracket aache, udaaharan [5].
Aam khelnaa saath, aam aapan guess aaraa itihaas niche jodaa jaaeba. E itihaas ka upayog karke aam khelnaa poora karein pahle aam aapan guess se baahar naa hoi.
Aam aapan guess likhe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Amaan khelnaa format bhul. Player {player_id} sahi '[number]' saath jawaab naa deeba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: ᱵᱟᱹᱞᱤ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱾ ᱠᱷᱮᱞᱚᱸᱰᱤᱭᱟᱹ {player_id} ᱫᱚ ᱮᱢ ᱟᱠᱟᱱ ᱦᱟᱨᱡᱟ ᱵᱟᱦᱨᱮ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱞᱮᱠᱷᱟᱭ ᱜᱚᱴᱟᱭᱮᱱᱟ᱾
invalid_move.already_guessed: ᱵᱟᱹᱞᱤ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜᱼᱟ ᱾ ᱠᱷᱮᱞᱚᱸᱰᱤᱭᱟᱹ {player_id} ᱫᱚ ᱮᱞ ᱜᱚᱴᱟ ᱟᱠᱟᱫᱟᱭ᱾

game_message.target_lower: ᱴᱟᱨᱜᱟᱴ ᱮᱞ ᱫᱚ ᱞᱟᱛᱟᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱟ ᱾
